blurb: NORR11 is a Danish design company based in Copenhagen. Its furniture translates Japanese simplicity into a Scandinavian context, with close attention to material and detail.
name: NORR11
tagline: Danish design with a Japanese sensibility.
short: A Copenhagen design house led by Kristian Sofus Hansen and Tommy Hyldahl, joining Japanese restraint with Scandinavian craft.
long: NORR11 is a Danish design company based in Copenhagen. Its two lead designers, Kristian Sofus Hansen and Tommy Hyldahl, translate the simplicity of Japanese design into a Scandinavian context, with a focus on quality, heritage and materiality.
